title: WorkOrder
description: Work order dispatched by jitterbugs to a security partner upon escalation.

work_order_id.description: UUID v4 assigned by jitterbugs at work-order creation.

event_id.description: UUID of the source escalation event that triggered this work order.

created_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the work order was created.

priority.description: Response urgency. P1 = immediate, P2 = standard, P3 = advisory.

required_response_level.description: Maps 1-to-1 with priority: P1→IMMEDIATE, P2→STANDARD, P3→ADVISORY.

location.description: Location of the terminal box that generated the escalation event.

source.description: Technology used to obtain the fix.

reverse_geocode.description: Human-readable address string (best-effort, may be absent).

site_contact.description: On-site contact for the responding partner (optional).

evidence.description: Short video clip evidence associated with the escalation (optional).

clip_url.description: Presigned HTTPS URL to download the clip. Valid for 60 minutes.

clip_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the clip file, prefixed 'sha256:'.

sla_deadline_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC deadline by which the partner must reach ONSCENE state.

server_signature.description: ed25519 signature by the jitterbugs server over SHA-256(canonical_work_order_json), Base64url-encoded.
